projects.name: llama.cpp
projects.description: The foundational C/C++ inference engine. GGUF format, runs on CPU, CUDA, Metal, Vulkan, ROCm. Powers most of the projects below.

projects.name: Ollama
projects.description: One-command model management on top of llama.cpp. The easiest "from zero to chatting" experience on macOS, Linux, and Windows.

projects.name: LM Studio
projects.description: Polished desktop app, GUI model browser, standard chat-completion API compatible local server. Free for personal use.

projects.name: Jan
projects.description: Fully open-source desktop alternative to LM Studio. Cross-platform, plugin system, MIT-licensed.

projects.name: vLLM
projects.description: High-throughput, production-grade inference server. PagedAttention, tensor parallelism, standard chat-completion API compatible API. Pick this when you're serving more than one user.

projects.name: SGLang
projects.description: Newer high-throughput serving runtime focused on structured generation and complex prompting. Often faster than vLLM on supported models.

projects.name: text-generation-webui
projects.description: Gradio web UI with broad backend support (Transformers, llama.cpp, ExLlama). The Swiss Army knife.

projects.name: koboldcpp
projects.description: Single-binary llama.cpp distribution with a friendly UI, popular for story writing and roleplay.

projects.name: mlx-lm
projects.description: Apple's MLX framework for native Apple Silicon inference. Best raw throughput on M-series Macs.

projects.name: MLC LLM
projects.description: Compile LLMs to run on phones, browsers, and embedded devices via TVM.

projects.name: LocalAI
projects.description: Drop-in replacement for the standard chat-completion API. Supports LLMs, image gen, TTS, STT, embeddings in one binary.

projects.name: exllamav2
projects.description: Fast inference of quantized models on consumer NVIDIA GPUs. Excellent for long-context use cases.

projects.name: mistral.rs
projects.description: Rust-based inference engine, focus on speed and a clean API. CUDA, Metal, CPU.

projects.name: llamafile
projects.description: Distribute a model as a single executable that runs everywhere. Magic for sharing.

projects.name: Nitro
projects.description: Embeddable inference engine from the Jan team.

projects.name: candle
projects.description: Hugging Face's minimalist ML framework in Rust. Good for embedding inference into Rust apps.

projects.name: TensorRT-LLM
projects.description: NVIDIA's high-performance inference library. Squeeze maximum tokens/sec out of a datacenter GPU.

projects.name: Open WebUI
projects.description: The de facto self-hosted chat UI. Multi-user, RAG built in, plugin system, runs on Docker in one command.

projects.name: LibreChat
projects.description: Polished multi-user chat UI. Bring-your-own keys for cloud models, but pairs cleanly with local backends.

projects.name: AnythingLLM
projects.description: All-in-one desktop app: chat + workspaces + RAG over your documents. Available as desktop binary or self-hosted server.

projects.name: GPT4All
projects.description: Friendly desktop chat client with a built-in model library. Solid first install for non-technical users.

projects.name: Msty
projects.description: Slick cross-platform chat app supporting local and cloud models side-by-side. Closed source but free tier is generous.

projects.name: h2oGPT
projects.description: Enterprise-flavored local LLM + RAG platform from H2O.ai.

projects.name: Lobe Chat
projects.description: Pretty chat UI with plugin system; can be pointed at any standard chat-completion API compatible local server.

projects.name: Big-AGI
projects.description: Feature-dense web UI: branching conversations, beam search, persona library.

projects.name: chatbox
projects.description: Cross-platform desktop client; speaks to local APIs.

projects.name: Page Assist
projects.description: Browser extension that lets local LLMs see your current page. Surprisingly useful.

projects.name: Enchanted
projects.description: Native macOS / iOS app for talking to Ollama instances.

projects.name: Sanctum
projects.description: macOS-native chat app, privacy-first framing.

projects.name: Continue
projects.description: Open-source autocomplete + chat for VS Code and JetBrains. Pluggable backend (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, llama.cpp, anything standard chat-completion API compatible).

projects.name: Tabby
projects.description: Self-hosted code completion server (Rust). Team-scale alternative to cloud autocomplete services.

projects.name: twinny
projects.description: VS Code extension specifically built for Ollama-backed autocomplete and chat.

projects.name: Aider
projects.description: Terminal-based pair programmer. Works fully offline with any local standard chat-completion API compatible endpoint.

projects.name: Cline
projects.description: Agentic coding extension for VS Code; supports local model endpoints.

projects.name: llama-coder
projects.description: VS Code extension; Ollama-only, focused on completions.

projects.name: Privy
projects.description: Open-source autocomplete + chat focused on privacy.

projects.name: Refact.ai
projects.description: Open-source self-hosted code assistant (chat + completions + agents).

projects.name: CodeGPT
projects.description: Pluggable VS Code / JetBrains extension; supports local providers.

projects.name: PrivateGPT
projects.description: Pioneering "chat with your docs, 100% local" project. Battle-tested foundation.

projects.name: kotaemon
projects.description: Open-source RAG UI focused on document Q&A; good citation/visualization story.

projects.name: Khoj
projects.description: Self-hostable AI second brain. Index notes, docs, email; queryable from Obsidian, Emacs, web.

projects.name: DocsGPT
projects.description: RAG specifically for project documentation. Embeddable widget for your docs site.

projects.name: Onyx
projects.description: Open-source enterprise search and chat across SaaS connectors. Self-hostable.

projects.name: Verba
projects.description: Weaviate's reference RAG app. Good code to learn from.

projects.name: RAGFlow
projects.description: Document-aware RAG with strong table/PDF parsing.

projects.name: Cognita
projects.description: Modular RAG framework with UI.

projects.name: LlamaIndex
projects.description: Library for building RAG and structured-data agents. Local-first if you wire it up that way.

projects.name: Haystack
projects.description: Production-oriented framework for search, RAG, and agents.

projects.name: Letta
projects.description: Stateful agents with long-term memory. Local-model friendly.

projects.name: Open Interpreter
projects.description: Run code on your machine via natural language. Local-model mode is well-supported.

projects.name: CrewAI

projects.name: AutoGen

projects.name: LangGraph
projects.description: Graph-based agent runtime from the LangChain team.

projects.name: Pydantic AI

projects.name: smolagents
projects.description: Hugging Face's minimalist agent library; code-first agents.

projects.name: AgentKit
projects.description: Full-stack starter for production-grade agents.

projects.name: ComfyUI

projects.name: Fooocus
projects.description: Friction-free SDXL image generation. No prompt-engineering tax.

projects.name: InvokeAI

projects.name: SD.Next
